rules.patch_base: For all subsequent work, use this exact LIVE baseline unless a newer CURRENT_RELEASE replaces it. Before deployment, still inspect current mysterylogic.com for concurrent live changes.
rules.github_actions_artifacts: Never treat a GitHub Actions artifact as the production baseline unless CURRENT_RELEASE.json explicitly points to it.
rules.small_changes: Prefer a minimal patch containing only changed production files.
rules.promotion: Normal promotion requires deploy -> live verification -> owner confirmation -> save verified full LIVE baseline -> update CURRENT_RELEASE.json.
rules.versioning: Do not invent semantic version numbers. Use only explicit release identifiers or dates.
